mapper.sql: id, organization_name, business_number, industry_type, employee_count, address, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, agreement_status, submitted_at, approved_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert:
SELECT organization_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO t_organization ( id, organization_name, business_number, industry_type, employee_count, address, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, agreement_status, submitted_at, approved_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationName}, #{businessNumber}, #{industryType}, #{employeeCount}, #{address}, #{contactName}, #{contactEmail}, #{contactPhone}, #{agreementStatus}, #{submittedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{reviewComment}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_organization SET industry_type = #{industryType}, employee_count = #{employeeCount}, address = #{address}, agreement_status = #{agreementStatus}, submitted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_organization o
ORDER BY o.submitted_at DESC, o.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE t_organization SET agreement_status = 'ACTIVE', approved_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND agreement_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE t_organization SET agreement_status = 'REJECTED', review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND agreement_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE t_organization SET industry_type = #{industryType}, employee_count = #{employeeCount}, address = #{address}, agreement_status = 'PENDING', submitted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, review_comment = NULL, approved_at = NULL, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND agreement_status = 'REJECTED'
